title: #clmooc existed, persisted in siloed spaces capitalism erases like many teachers called Google+ our home until, corporate greed left us alone lost so
summary: #clmooc existed, persisted in siloed spaces capitalism erases like many teachers called Google+ our home until, corporate greed left us alone lost so we roam in spaces we own web rings and rss feeds silent sundays weekend haikus
author: Greg McVerry
body_html:
#clmooc
existed, persisted
in siloed spaces
capitalism erases
like many teachers
called
Google+ our home
until, corporate greed
left us alone
lost
so we roam
in spaces we own
web rings
and rss feeds
silent sundays
weekend haikus
